description: Comptages routiers sur la voirie de l'agglomération - 2020 / 2021 is a dataset listed in data.nimes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Nîmes Métropole. Les points de comptages routiers permettent d'évaluer le trafic des voitures et poids lourds sur les routes des communes de l'agglomération de Nîmes. Ce jeu de données renseigne pour chacun des points de comptage le trafic heure par heure des véhicules circulant (tous types), tous sens confondus, au cours d'une journée. Coverage: Nîmes Métropole. The portal files it under Transports et Mobilité. Its keywords are Route, Voirie, Trafic, Réseau, Comptage routier. The portal shows 604,779 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-04-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nimes-metropole-fr-portal.
